clippings.speaker: Denzel Washington
clippings.quote: Tony, like myself, likes research. He always tracks down real guys who do [the jobs portrayed]. We did it with Man on Fire. We did it with Crimson Tide.
clippings.title: Deja Vu: An Interview with Denzel Washington
clippings.context: Asked how he prepared for the ATF role in Déjà Vu, he describes Scott's research habits.

clippings.speaker: Denzel Washington
clippings.quote: He knows how I like to work, and I know what he likes to do. For example he knows I like a lot of research so he is going to have a ton of stuff before we start production things like that.
clippings.title: Unstoppable/ Denzel Washington and Rosario Dawson Interview
clippings.context: Asked about their shorthand after five films together, he explains how Scott prepares ahead of a shoot.

clippings.speaker: Tony Scott
clippings.quote: I respect his process and he respects mine, and both of us are insecure in that we're always examining and making what we do better…
clippings.title: Interview: Tony Scott
clippings.context: In a roundtable with online journalists promoting Pelham, asked about the shorthand after working together so often.

clippings.speaker: Tony Scott
clippings.quote: he's always managed to find a different aspect of his personality that we've honed.
clippings.title: Tony Scott on Denzel Washington: 'He delivers'
clippings.context: In a 2010 interview with David Poland, asked what connected them across their films; TheGrio quotes it after Scott's death, and the original was not reachable.

clippings.speaker: Tony Scott
clippings.quote: He's tough because he's always reaching for a difference. He's always trying not to repeat himself and I do the same.
clippings.title: Tony Scott on Denzel Washington: 'He delivers'
clippings.context: Said to Empire during press junket coverage of Unstoppable, asked why they keep working together; TheGrio quotes it, and the Empire original was not reachable.

notes: Denzel's Unstoppable interview with blackfilm and CinemaBlend's Pelham roundtable were the richest sources. Collider pages and the Phase9 Q&As were blocked (403 or unreachable); the Empire and Movie City News originals were not reachable, so those two Scott quotes come via TheGrio and are marked secondhand. Denzel-side lines are from separate exchanges; only one Scott quote came from each of several interviews.
